annotations.title: Add a frame to the library

description:
[writes flayr data · `write` scope] Copy a flayr frame into the brand library (`defaultKey`, optional colors/texts), or add uploaded PNG/SVG art (upload_media first; `variants` of storageIds, the content area is detected from transparency).
(Wraps POST /api/v2/frames.)

paletteOverride.description: Colors that win over the brand kit.

rights.description: Who holds the rights to the art. Optional; a frame without it shows a reminder.

texts.description: Texts some frames print (ribbon/tag label, lower-third title/subtitle).

aspect.description: Default: nearest to the image size.

contentBox.description: Default: detected from the transparent area. Where the post sits inside the frame, as fractions (0–1) of the frame canvas.

storageId.description: From POST /api/v2/media/upload-url, then POST the PNG (with transparency) or SVG bytes.

name: create_frame
title: Add a frame to the library
